summary: Added three ECS rules to the cfn-lint repo, none committed. E3052 (FargateTaskNetworkMode) requires NetworkMode awsvpc on FARGATE task definitions. E3053 (FargateServiceNetworkConfiguration) requires NetworkConfiguration.AwsvpcConfiguration on FARGATE services. E3054 (ServiceHealthCheckGracePeriod) requires at least one LoadBalancers entry when HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds is set. The spec did not name the rules, so I chose these; the user should confirm against issue #1547. Files: three rule classes in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/, three schema extensions under data/schemas/extensions/aws_ecs_*, three unit test files, and three rows in docs/rules.md added by hand. Results: 73 ECS unit tests pass. Full unit suite 1531 passed, 1 failed (test_build_graph needs pygraphviz/pydot, absent from the venv). test_formatters.py was excluded because defusedxml is missing. Integration: 14 passed, 4 failed; the quickstart failures are pre-existing (identical exit code on the base tree) and test_junit is the missing defusedxml. The only existing fixture where a new rule fires is the deliberately bad resources_circular_dependency.yaml. Known gaps: E3053 still fires on NetworkConfiguration: !Ref alongside the existing E1020 type error; black and ruff were unavailable so formatting and lint were not checked.
